definitions.explanation: Not conforming to established rules, standards, or regular patterns. Used broadly for anything outside the standard or official category.
Describes workers or employment arrangements that fall outside the standard full-time permanent employment model, including part-time, temporary, contract, and dispatch workers.

examples.japanese: {非正規|ひせいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧だ。
{非正規|ひせいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入手|にゅうしゅ}→入手：11636_nyuushu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was obtained through irregular means.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非正規|ひせいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This document was submitted through unofficial channels.

examples.japanese: {非正規|ひせいき}{雇用|こよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非正規|ひせいき}{社員|しゃいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: She is working as a non-regular employee.

examples.japanese: {非正規|ひせいき}{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{待遇|たいぐう}→待遇：12517_taiguu⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧な⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Improving the treatment of non-regular workers has become a social issue.

notes:
Formed from the prefix ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ (non-) and ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧ (regular; official). Most commonly encountered in employment contexts, where the distinction between ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧ and {非正規|ひせいき} is a major social and economic issue in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非正規|ひせいき}{雇用|こよう}: non-regular employment
- {非正規|ひせいき}{社員|しゃいん}: non-regular employee
- {非正規|ひせいき}{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}: non-regular worker
- {非正規|ひせいき}⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧: non-regular labor
- {非正規|ひせいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧: proportion of non-regular (workers)

EMPLOYMENT CONTEXT:
{非正規|ひせいき}{雇用|こよう} includes part-time workers (⟦パート→パート：03106_paato⟧), temporary workers (⟦{派遣|はけん}{社員|しゃいん}→派遣社員：18875_hakenshain⟧), contract workers (⟦{契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}→契約社員：12260_keiyakushain⟧), and casual workers (⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧). These positions typically offer lower pay, fewer benefits, and less job security than ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧ (regular full-time employment).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧: fraud; injustice — implies wrongdoing, while {非正規|ひせいき} simply means outside the standard category
- ⟦{不規則|ふきそく}→不規則：15651_fukisoku⟧: irregular; random — describes lack of pattern, not employment status
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧: temporary; ad hoc — focuses on the temporary nature rather than the employment category
